ABOUT CR POWER
關於華潤電力
China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited (the                    華潤電力控股有限公司（「本公司」或「華
“Company” or “CR Power”) mainly invests, develops, operates            潤電力」）主要在中華人民共和國（「中國」）
and manages wind farms, photovoltaic power plants, hydro-              投 資、開 發、運 營 和 管 理 風 電 場、光 伏
electric power plants and other clean and renewable energy             電 站、水 電 站 及 其 他 清 潔 及 可 再 生 能 源
projects and coal-fired power plants in the People’s Republic of       項 目 和 燃 煤 發 電 廠。業 務 還 涉 及 分 佈 式
China (“China” or the “PRC”). Its business also covers distributed     能源、售電、智慧能源及煤炭等領域。
energy, power sales, smart energy, coal mining, and other areas.

plants, 221 wind farms, 221 photovoltaic power plants, 20 hydro-       網 50 座燃煤發電廠、221 座風電場、221
electric power plants and 6 gas-fired power plants in commercial       座 光 伏 電 站、20 座 水 電 站 和 6 座 燃 氣 發
operations. Its total attributable grid-connected installed capacity   電 廠。本 公 司 的 合 計 權 益 併 網 裝 機 容 量
was 89,647MW, with 25.5% of its capacity located in Central            為 89,647 兆 瓦，其 中 25.5% 位 於 華 中 地

creating long-term value for the Company. CR Power’s inclusion         選恒生 ESG 50 指數以及恒生可持續發展

      Amendments to HKFRS 9 and HKFRS 7 Amendments                       香港財務報告準則第9號及香港財
      to the Classification and Measurement of Financial                 務 報 告 準 則 第 7 號（修 訂 本）金 融 工
      Instruments                                                        具分類及計量之修訂
      The amendments to HKFRS 9 “Financial Instruments”                   香 港 財 務 報 告 準 則 第 9 號（修 訂 本）
      (“HKFRS 9”) clarify the recognition and derecognition for          「金融工具」釐清金融資產與金融負
      financial asset and financial liability and add an exception        債之確認及終止確認，並增加一項
      which permits an entity to deem a financial liability to be         例外情況，即當且僅當符合若干條
      discharged before the settlement date if it is settled in cash      件時，允許實體將採用電子支付系
      using an electronic payment system if, and only if certain          統以現金結付之金融負債視為已於
      conditions are met.                                                 結付日期前解除。

      The amendments also provide guidance on the assessment             該等修訂本亦就評估金融資產之合
      of whether the contractual cash flows of a financial               約現金流量是否與基本借貸安排相
      asset are consistent with a basic lending arrangement.             一 致 提 供 指 引。該 等 修 訂 本 訂 明，
      The amendments specify that an entity should focus on              實體應專注於實體獲得補償的項目
      what an entity is being compensated for rather than                而非補償金額。若合約現金流量與
      the compensation amount. Contractual cash flows are                並非基本借貸風險或成本的變數掛
      inconsistent with a basic lending arrangement if they are          鈎，則 其 與 基 本 借 貸 安 排 不 一 致。
      indexed to a variable that is not a basic lending risk or cost.    該 等 修 訂 本 表 明，在 部 分 情 況 下，
      The amendments state that, in some cases, a contingent             或然特徵可能於合約現金流量變動
      feature may give rise to contractual cash flows that are           之前及之後產生與基本借貸安排一
      consistent with a basic lending arrangement both before            致之合約現金流量，惟或然事件本
      and after the change in contractual cash flows, but the            身之性質與基本借貸風險及成本之
      nature of the contingent event itself does not relate directly     變 化 並 不 直 接 相 關。此 外，該 等 修
      to changes in basic lending risks and costs. Furthermore,          訂本中加強對「無追索權」一詞之描
      the description of the term “non-recourse” is enhanced and         述以及釐清「合約掛鈎工具」之特點。
      the characteristics of “contractually linked instruments” are
      clarified in the amendments.

   JUDGEMENTS AND KEY SOURCES OF                                            朗因素的主要來源
   ESTIMATION UNCERTAINTY
      In the application of the Group’s accounting policies, which        於應用附註3所載之本集團會計政

47. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                             47. 資本風險管理
      The Group’s objectives in managing capital are to safeguard         本集團資本管理旨在保障本集團的
      the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order         持續經營能力，以向股東提供回報
      to provide returns for shareholders and benefits for other          及向其他利益相關者提供裨益，維
      stakeholders and to maintain an optimal capital structure in        持優化的資本結構，以降低資本成
      order to reduce the cost of capital.                                本。

      In order to maintain or adjust the capital structure, the Group     為維持或調整資本結構，本集團或
      may adjust the amount of dividends paid to shareholders,            會調整派付予股東的股息金額、返
      return capital to shareholders, issue new shares or sell assets     還資本予股東、發行新股或出售資
      to reduce debt.                                                     產以減少債務。

      The Group monitors its capital based on gearing ratio. This         本集團根據資本負債比率監察其資
      ratio is calculated as net debt divided by total equity. Net        本。該比率按債務淨額除以總權益
      debt is calculated as total borrowings and loans from related       計算。債務淨額按借貸總額及來自
      companies less cash and cash equivalents and pledged and            關聯公司的貸款減現金及現金等價
      restricted bank deposits.                                           物與已抵押及受限制銀行存款計算。

      The gearing ratios at 31 December 2025 and 2024 are as              於 2025 年 及 2024 年 12 月 31 日 的 資
      follows:                                                            本負債比率如下：
